title: Ruby before 3.3.14, 3.4.13, and 4.0.10 has a heap-based buffer overflow during case conversion. (CVE-2026-132825)
description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in Ruby versions before 3.3.14, 3.4.13, and 4.0.10 during case conversion operations. This flaw allows one byte to be written outside the intended buffer, affecting character encodings such as ISO-8859-1 and Windows-1252.
